what: Correction: rung 2's second L40S run recorded vLLM 0.34.0's own fused-MoE setting as failing (Triton OutOfResources) at every step size. A harness fault caused that, not the engine.
cause: vLLM 0.34.0 vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/__init__.py override_config (tag v0.34.0, 62d4bc3c, lines 53-59) sets a module global, yields, and restores it with no try/finally. A searched setting that raised OutOfResources inside it stayed in force; every later engine-default call (no override, so it reads the global) ran the failed setting.
evidence_in_the_run: From 8 tokens up, the recorded engine choice for E=128,N=768 was {BLOCK_SIZE_M 64, BLOCK_SIZE_N 256, BLOCK_SIZE_K 256, GROUP_SIZE_M 1, 4 warps, 5 stages}, identical to the candidate that failed at that step size; vLLM's get_default_config at 8 tokens gives {16, 64, 128, 1, 4 warps, 3 stages}.
The engine failure needed the same 164,864 bytes at every step size from 8 to 2048, although the true default changes with the batch size.
At 1 token the failure needed 105,472 bytes, the same as the failed candidate {16, 256, 128, 1, 4 warps, 4 stages} at that step size.
source_check_sm89: vLLM 0.34.0 on SM89 selects the TRITON FP8 MoE backend (FlashInfer CUTLASS needs SM90/100/120, DeepGEMM Hopper; swap-AB and TMA are Hopper/Blackwell only), which calls get_default_config: small tiles with 3-4 stages for block FP8. The untuned engine is expected to serve on an L40S; rung 3's gap check confirms it with one real start.

fix.what: tune_moe.setting restores the global in every case; the engine's own choice refuses to run under an override (HarnessError); BLOCK_SIZE_K above the quantization block is not searched (the engine clamps it)
fix.unit_test: OverrideIsRestored in tools/kernel-tune/test_kernel_tune.py: a stub of vLLM's exact override_config reproduces the false finding with the old handling

what_still_holds: Each searched setting's time in that run was taken under its own override and stands; 2-3 settings per step size do not fit the L40S. No gain against the engine default is known from that run.
